title: Close, charge or void an aesthetic session
summary: Review what was applied, charge, send aftercare, schedule the follow-up and close; afterwards, amendments or voiding.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Tap the aesthetic session
steps.details: You can tell it by its status (Draft, In treatment, Ready to close, Closed…). Tapping it expands it. If the patient has none, create one first with Create → Aesthetic session.

steps.title: Continue session
steps.details: Resumes at the first step still missing. A closed or void session opens read-only.

steps.title: What is missing
steps.details: Tap each notice to go to the step that solves it.

steps.title: Treatment applied
steps.details: Each service with its zones, total, lots used and today's photos. An expired lot shows in red.

steps.title: Session summary
steps.details: Free text kept on the patient's timeline, along with the notes taken during the session.

steps.title: Charge
steps.details: "Charge" opens billing with the session's services already filled in. The invoice stays linked: its total, amount paid, balance and payments show here and can be printed. Charging is not required to close.

steps.title: Aftercare and next appointment
steps.details: Sends each service's aftercare by WhatsApp and schedules the follow-up on the suggested date. Both are set in the service's Aesthetics tab.

steps.title: Activity
steps.details: Who signed, uploaded photos, added notes or closed, and when.

steps.title: Void session
steps.details: Asks for a reason and leaves the session read-only. Nothing is deleted. Only an open session can be deleted, from the timeline.

steps.title: Amendments
steps.details: In a closed session, corrections are added as an amendment, without erasing the original.

steps.title: Close session
steps.details: Asks for confirmation. It requires everything signed, a photo (unless not applicable) and each service with at least one mark with a quantity.
